chunks: It has been narrated from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام that he said:

The milk of the baby girl and her urine must be washed from the garment before she eats, because her milk comes out from her mother's bladder. And the milk of the baby boy is not washed from the garment before he eats, nor is his urine, because the milk of the baby boy comes out from the shoulders and the upper arms.
ai.seo_question: Does the milk or urine of an infant boy or girl need to be washed from clothing before the child starts eating food?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the purity of clothing in relation to the milk and urine of infant girls and boys before they begin eating food. It belongs to the jurisprudential discussion of ritual purity and impurity in early childhood.
